# Microsoft Defender for Storage - Price Estimation

**Version 4.3** - Separate views for coverage, storage costs, and scanning costs.

[Workbook guide and version history on GitHub](https://github.com/Azure/Microsoft-Defender-for-Cloud/tree/main/Workbooks/Microsoft%20Defender%20for%20Storage%20Price%20Estimation#readme)
## This workbook is designed to provide a cost estimate for Microsoft Defender for Storage. The estimate includes the estimated cost of scanning for malware upon upload.

### Cost of Microsoft Defender for storage

The cost is $10 per storage account per month. However, storage accounts with an exceptionally high transaction volume (above 73 million monthly transactions) will incur an overage charge of $0.1492 per 1 million transactions for transactions that exceed the 73 million threshold.

Please note that the actual pricing may vary based on the type of agreement made with Microsoft, the date of purchase, and the currency exchange rate. For more detailed information, please visit the [Defender for Cloud pricing](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/defender-for-cloud/) page.

#### Please select the scope:
Due to Azure Monitor’s limitations, please limit your selection of subscriptions and storage accounts as it can only display up to 250 rows.

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.description: Please select one or several subscriptions to allow the workbook to calculate Defender for Cloud cost.

parameters.name: Storage
parameters.label: Storage accounts
parameters.description: Please select one or several storage accounts to calculate the estimated cost for Defender for Storage
parameters.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts'
| order by name asc
| extend Rank = row_number()
| project value = id

content.json: ## Microsoft Defender for Storage coverage by subscriptions

This table provides an overview of all selected subscriptions and their corresponding Defender status per plan. You can click the on/off status per plan and subscription. Doing so, you will be redirected to the subscription's Defender for Cloud plan configuration page. With that, you can easily see your Defender for Cloud coverage per subscription and immediately react in case you want to enable additional plans on it.

content.query:
// DF-Storage Plans
securityresources
| where type == "microsoft.security/pricings"
| where name == "StorageAccounts"
| extend pricingTier = properties.pricingTier
| extend DefenderForStoragePlan = properties.subPlan
| extend IsInTrialPeriod = properties.freeTrialRemainingTime
| extend Extensions = array_concat(properties.extensions, dynamic([{}]))
| mv-expand Extension = Extensions
| extend ExtensionName = tostring(Extension.name)
| summarize MalwareScanningEnabled = take_anyif(tostring(Extension.isEnabled), ExtensionName =~ "OnUploadMalwareScanning"),
    MalwareScanningCapping = take_anyif(tostring(Extension.additionalExtensionProperties.CapGBPerMonthPerStorageAccount), ExtensionName =~ "OnUploadMalwareScanning"),
    SensitiveDataDiscoveryEnabled = take_anyif(tostring(Extension.isEnabled), ExtensionName =~ "SensitiveDataDiscovery")
    by subscriptionId, pricingTier = tostring(pricingTier), DefenderForStoragePlan = tostring(DefenderForStoragePlan), IsInTrialPeriod = tostring(IsInTrialPeriod)
| extend IsEnabled = iff(pricingTier == "Free", "Disabled", "Enabled"), 
    DefenderForStoragePlan  = iff(isnull(DefenderForStoragePlan ), "", DefenderForStoragePlan ), 
    MalwareScanningEnabled = iff(isnull(MalwareScanningEnabled), "", MalwareScanningEnabled), 
    MalwareScanningCapping = iff(isnull(MalwareScanningCapping), "", MalwareScanningCapping), 
    SensitiveDataDiscoveryEnabled = iff(isnull(SensitiveDataDiscoveryEnabled), "", SensitiveDataDiscoveryEnabled),
    IsInTrialPeriod = case(isempty(tostring(IsInTrialPeriod)), "Unknown", IsInTrialPeriod == "PT0S", "No", "Yes")
| project subscriptionId, IsInTrialPeriod, IsEnabled, DefenderForStoragePlan, MalwareScanningEnabled, MalwareScanningCapping, SensitiveDataDiscoveryEnabled

content.json:
#### Please be aware that the provided estimate is based on the telemetry data from your resources and standard retail pricing. It’s important to understand that this does not represent your actual billed amount and it does not account for any discounts in your environment. For accurate cost information, please refer to your actual billing information.

**Read-operation calculation errors:** `No "matrix" implementation available` is a workbook expression error, not a malware finding. This workbook fixes the array-wrapped read-operation formula; reimport the updated JSON if a saved copy still shows it. Until corrected, affected read-operation estimates and their totals are incomplete, not zero. `$0.00` can reflect rounding of an observed numeric value; it does not confirm zero billable usage.

This workbook estimates malware scanning costs based on the total volume of blobs uploaded, as indicated by Blob Ingress metrics. Please consider the following:

- **Multiple scans:** Specific upload methods, such as `PutBlockList` operations, may trigger multiple scans for a single blob (e.g., when writing logs to the same blob). This tool does not accurately capture the additional costs from multiple scans triggered by such operations.
- **Blob size:** The estimation accounts for all uploaded blobs; however, only blobs smaller than 50GB are actually scanned.

**Associated-cost amounts:** Event Grid, read-operation, and index-tag amounts are numeric USD estimates, displayed with 2-7 decimal places to show sub-cent costs. Older copies could concatenate numeric values with text zeros in grouped totals; those long strings are not valid costs. Reimport the updated workbook to apply the numeric-total fix.

**Associated costs to Malware Protection**
- **Index Tag costs:** The estimation is based on a 7 day sample. Learn more on index tags costs in the [Azure Storage Blobs Pricing](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/storage/blobs/ "https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/storage/blobs/") page.
- **Read Operations**: The estimation, based on a 7 day sample, accounts for the read operations that happen when EventGrid events are triggered. The price used in this calculation, is Read operations (per 10,000) in Hot tier. 
- **EventGrid**: The estimation is based on a 7 day sample, and accounts for the EventGrid events triggered when blobs are scanned for malware.




**Missing metrics:** blank activity, ingress, event, or index observations remain unknown, not zero. An observed numeric zero is valid. The metrics-status column flags affected account rows; grouped sums include known values only and are not complete scope totals if any input is missing. Accounts with no activity-metric row cannot be listed by these metric-based views. Missing File or Blob service metrics are conservatively unknown because these views do not discover service applicability. Use the PowerShell estimator for endpoint-aware completeness checks.

parameters.name: ModeledScanningCapGB
parameters.label: Modeled cap (GB/month/account; -1 = uncapped)
parameters.description: Scenario only, not a discovered setting. Enter -1 for uncapped or a nonnegative integer. Model accounts with different caps separately.

paramValidationRules.message: Enter -1 (uncapped) or a whole number from 0 to 999999999.

content.json:
### 🧮 Storage costs

Monthly estimates for activity monitoring and on-upload malware scanning. Additional Event Grid, read-operation, and index-tag estimates are on the **Scanning costs** tab.

**Missing metrics:** blank activity, ingress, event, or index observations remain unknown, not zero. An observed numeric zero is valid. The metrics-status column flags affected account rows; grouped sums include known values only and are not complete scope totals if any input is missing. Accounts with no activity-metric row cannot be listed by these metric-based views. Missing File or Blob service metrics are conservatively unknown because these views do not discover service applicability. Use the PowerShell estimator for endpoint-aware completeness checks.

**Scanning scenario: cap = {ModeledScanningCapGB} GB/month per account (-1 means uncapped).** The default is explicitly an uncapped scenario, not the configured account setting. Configured account overrides and disabled scanning are not discovered or applied. Filter and model accounts with different caps separately. The cap applies to each account's projected scanning volume before costing; estimated uploaded bytes remain uncapped. Missing ingress is unknown even with a zero cap.

This cap is a nominal scenario, not a guaranteed billing ceiling. Configured scanning can exceed its threshold by up to 20 GB; this simple model does not add that deviation. [Scanning cap behavior](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/on-upload-malware-scanning#cost-control-for-on-upload-malware-scanning).

content.json:
### 🐞 Scanning costs

Event Grid, read-operation, and index-tag estimates use the seven-day sample. Monthly estimates for activity monitoring and on-upload malware scanning are on the **Storage costs** tab.

**Gross Event Grid estimate:** sampled upload-operation count multiplied by $0.60/million, before the shared monthly free allowance. The allowance is not deducted per account or from a seven-day sample. Other operations, payload size, usage outside this scope, pricing and billing can differ; this is neither an invoice nor a strict upper bound.

**Missing metrics:** blank activity, ingress, event, or index observations remain unknown, not zero. An observed numeric zero is valid. The metrics-status column flags affected account rows; grouped sums include known values only and are not complete scope totals if any input is missing. Accounts with no activity-metric row cannot be listed by these metric-based views. Missing File or Blob service metrics are conservatively unknown because these views do not discover service applicability. Use the PowerShell estimator for endpoint-aware completeness checks.

**Scan-trigger proxy:** counts PutBlob, CopyBlob, PutBlockList, FlushFile, and CreatePathFile transactions, separately from ingress bytes. PutBlock, PutBlockFromURL, and AppendFile are incremental writes and are not counted as independent scan triggers. FlushFile metrics cannot distinguish flush-with-close, and asynchronous copies, renames, repeated commits, exclusions, failed operations and actual event delivery can differ. These counts are not measured scans or billable Event Grid operations.

Associated-cost proxies are not reduced by the modeled scanning-GB cap: the number of actually scanned blobs after a cap, filters, or disabled scanning is unknown.
